comment: Canonical MCP server list for this repository. Path-free on purpose: sync.mjs resolves each binary on the current machine, because GUI-launched agents do not inherit the shell PATH and a committed absolute path would be wrong elsewhere. Run `node .agents/sync.mjs` after editing.

skills.comment: Repo-specific skills. .github/skills holds the procedures; .qoder/skills holds those plus thin pointers. Copied verbatim into each agent's project skills root.

github.note: Requires per-app authentication. Qoder and Copilot do OAuth in-app. Agents that cannot do dynamic client registration (Codex) read a token from the named environment variable instead; the token itself is never written to any file.
